title: Woordenboek Grieks-Nederlands
contributors: Funding Agency: NWO- Spinoza prize Sluiter
descriptions: This data set contains data created in the CLARIN GrNe project. In this project, we have curated part of the Ancient Greek - Dutch dictionary (during this project under construction at Leiden University) from MS Word to XML and created an online edition (www.woordenboekgrieks.nl). The data set consists of the XML of the lemmata starting with the Greek letter Pi, the source code of the software used to migrate the lemmata from MS Word to XML, the XML Schema, the webserver scripts used for the lemmatizer and configuration files to facilitate working with the XML in oXygen XML Editor.
